detail.longDescription: 1Password disclosed that malicious code pushed through one employee's GitHub account made backend services pull customer records. The intruder also copied private source and reached CI/CD. Entry method and affected data fields not disclosed. Defenders: alert on pushes, workflow edits and deploy keys from out-of-scope identities. Require signed commits, short-lived OIDC and reviewed workflow files. # ThreatIntel # SupplyChain # GitHub
